title: Date squares
hookLine: Canadian-inspired date squares with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Date squares
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease an 8-inch (20 cm) square baking pan. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m53338_1}, {m53338_2}, {m53338_3}, and {m53338_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure pitted dates first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Date squares
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the date filing: Combine the dates and water in a medium saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer gently, stirring occasionally until the mixture thickens, around 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and let cool. Set aside. Incorporate {m53338_5}, {m53338_6}, {m53338_7}, {m53338_8}, and {m53338_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Date squares
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine rolled oats, flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a food processor. Pulse 3 times (careful not to overmix, you don’t want the mixture to be powdery, just combined). Add butter and pulse again until the mixture is crumbly in pea-sized clumps. Transfer to a mixing bowl to thoroughly mix in the butter.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Date squares
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread half of the oat mixture on the bottom of the prepared baking pan, pressing down to make a flat, equal bottom later. Add the date mixture over the crust and then spread evenly. Layer with the remaining oat mixture and press down to flatten the top layer.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Date squares
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in the centre of the oven until the top is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan before cutting and serving. Date Squares keep well, covered in the refrigerator for up to a week, and frozen for 2 to 3 months.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
